lines.text: A 03:38 ET, September 29, 2026 secondary-news headline reported a partnership for phishing-resistant biometric authentication in UAE and Saudi Arabia. The desk grades the news as legitimate positive, but the supplied headline discloses no partnership economics, contractual commitments, or primary-company confirmation; no float the desk can independently verify, with 1,436,344 shares outstanding as of August 11, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), alongside registered resale and warrant capacity. The sheet marks the name yellow, frontside warning, up 32.2% since the previous checkpoint.

On September 28, 2026, the company announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by BRC Group Holdings, a strong news-driven catalyst corroborated by company and newswire sources. Transaction consideration, closing conditions, shareholder approvals, and timing are not established; no float the desk can independently verify, with 33,338,932 shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), and registered-resale and warrant capacity of unknown status. The sheet marks the name green, fresh / frontside.

At 07:35 ET, September 29, 2026, the company announced a merger agreement under which Transom Capital Group would acquire the company through a tender offer for $8.00 per share in cash plus one contingent value right worth up to $3.00 per share. The desk grades the news strong, while closing conditions, regulatory steps, financing, and CVR milestones are not supplied; no float the desk can independently verify, with 13,163,790 shares outstanding as of August 5, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), plus other issued-share capacity. The sheet marks the name green, fresh / frontside.

At 07:38 ET, September 29, 2026, secondary coverage attributed the move to an assertion of meeting Nasdaq’s $2.5 million equity requirement after acquisitions, with a September 28, 2026 Form 6-K supplying the corporate-event backdrop. The desk grades the catalyst moderate / mixed / secondary because the supplied primary excerpt does not establish the compliance conclusion; no float the desk can independently verify, with registered resale, convertible, and acquisition-share capacity. The sheet gives no cycle conclusion and records down 13.1% since the previous checkpoint.

At 13:30 ET, September 28, 2026, a securities purchase agreement covered 667,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.50 per share for $1,000,500 in gross proceeds, plus Series A and Series B warrants, to support an acquisition interest. The desk grades the fresh news weak / negative / dilutive; closing, issuance, registration, resale eligibility, and full warrant terms are not established, with no float the desk can independently verify and 16,957,000 shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), alongside placement, warrant, and acquisition-share capacity. The sheet gives no cycle conclusion.

At 17:05 ET, September 28, 2026, a company-disclosed term sheet proposed an AIxC acquisition of the robotics business at an expected $200 million purchase price paid in common and non-voting convertible preferred stock. The desk grades the event moderate / mixed / secondary, while definitive documentation, closing, the securities received, and their eventual liquidity are not established; no float the desk can independently verify. The sheet gives no cycle conclusion.

At 05:31 ET, September 29, 2026, secondary coverage reported favorable analyst initiation with a $3.50 price target. The desk grades the fresh news moderate / mixed / secondary, but no company release for the coverage is supplied; no float the desk can independently verify, with 127,255,223 shares outstanding as of July 24, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), plus active ATM and shelf capacity. The sheet gives no cycle conclusion.

At 07:15 ET, September 29, 2026, the company announced a trial order for 50 propane-fueled DC generators from a major Southeast Asian telecom operator, while secondary coverage described a potential five-year opportunity of up to $60 million in revenue. The desk grades the news legitimate positive, but the order value, delivery schedule, margins, customer identity, and larger program are not established; no float the desk can independently verify, with registered resale, convertible, equity-purchase, preferred-conversion, and warrant capacity. The sheet gives no cycle conclusion.
